Purple energy Bison uses to body-hop and dominate.

How Psycho Power connects

  • Character: M. Bison — M. Bison rules and body-hops through Psycho Power.
  • Faction: Shadaloo — Psycho Power is the energy cult at the center of Shadaloo.

What is Psycho Power?

Psycho Power is Shadaloo's signature energy: the force that lets M. Bison possess new bodies, empower Dolls, and corrupt fighters who get too close.

Key threads lead to M. Bison and Shadaloo.
